title: EffectWAM: Learning Action-Grounded Effects for Robot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32053v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World-action models connect visual prediction with executable robot control. We present EffectWAM, which develops this connection through three complementary components: Effect, camera positional encoding (CaPE), and Action Grounding. Effect represents visual change as the difference between independently encoded future observations and a shared current-observation anchor. CaPE conditions endpoint pooling on relative camera pose when reliable extrinsics are available, while sharing the same learned parameters with pose-free pooling for uncalibrated trajectories. Action Grounding trains the visual representation to retain measured changes in end-effector pose and gripper state. An exponential moving average of the observation encoder supplies Effect targets. A shared generation expert learns to jointly predict Effect and an executable action chunk through flow matching, and reuses the sampled pair to generate future video on demand. This

translated_title: EffectWAM：为机器人操作学习基于动作的效应
translated_abstract: 世界-动作模型将视觉预测与可执行的机器人控制连接起来。我们提出EffectWAM，它通过三个互补组件发展了这种连接：Effect、相机位置编码和动作接地。Effect将视觉变化表示为独立编码的未来观测与共享的当前观测锚点之间的差异。当可靠的外参可用时，CaPE基于相对相机位姿对端点池化进行条件化，同时对于未标定的轨迹，与无位姿池化共享相同的学习参数。动作接地训练视觉表示以保留末端执行器位姿和夹爪状态的测量变化。观测编码器的指数移动平均提供Effect目标。一个共享的生成专家学习通过流匹配联合预测Effect和可执行的动作块，并重用采样得到的动作对按需生成未来视频。
tldr: EffectWAM通过Effect视觉变化表示、相机位置编码和动作接地三个互补组件，利用流匹配联合预测视觉效应与可执行动作，将视觉预测与可执行的机器人控制紧密连接起来。
en_tdlr: EffectWAM is a world-action model that bridges visual prediction and executable robot control through three complementary components—Effect, camera positional encoding (CaPE), and Action Grounding—jointly predicting visual effects and action chunks via flow matching.
